say:1:1621743001:1.text: The library's packed... Is it always like this?
say:1:1621743001:1.source_cn: 图书馆里好多人啊……平时人有这么多吗？

say:2:1621743002:1.text: Everyone must be cramming for the final exam. I know this feeling all too well.
say:2:1621743002:1.source_cn: 肯定是因为大考要来了，大家都在临时突击复习。我最熟悉这个了。

say:3:1621743003:1.text: Girod doesn't seem to be here. He's probably done studying and headed home.
say:3:1621743003:1.source_cn: 我刚刚去看了一圈，吉罗德不在这里，可能已经复习完回去了吧。

say:4:1621743004:1.text: Are we just out of luck or what? We keep missing him!
say:4:1621743004:1.source_cn: 怎么今天这么倒霉，每次都刚好错开！

say:5:1621743005:1.text: Doesn't matter; we had to come here to research the mirror's magic anyway. We can look for Girod later.
say:5:1621743005:1.source_cn: 算了，反正我们本来也要来图书馆找古代魔法的资料。先找资...

say:6:1621743006:1.text: Actually, we don't have to all work on the research, do we? I wonder if that novel on Girod's desk is available here—
say:6:1621743006:1.source_cn: 说起来，资料也不用四个人一起找吧？我对吉罗德桌上那本《...

say:7:1621743007:1.text: Really? You're still thinking about that novel?
say:7:1621743007:1.source_cn: 都什么时候了，你怎么还想着找小说！

say:8:1621743008:1.text: I just think it might give us a clue! Girod, who never touches horror novels, suddenly reads one in class. Doesn't that seem fishy?
say:8:1621743008:1.source_cn: 不是找小说，是找线索！吉罗德从来不看恐怖小说，最近却在...

say:9:1621743009:1.text: Very fishy. Leo, I'll help you! This is way more fun than poring through articles.
say:9:1621743009:1.source_cn: 可疑，太可疑了。利奥，我帮你一起找！这可比找文献有意思多了。

say:10:1621743010:1.text: Fine, you two go ahead. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we can <style="highlight">do the research</style>.
say:10:1621743010:1.source_cn: 好吧好吧……你们去找那本小说。<style=stres...
